'''Cream chipped bantha beef''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] that was sold at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />  on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The diner sold cream chipped bantha beef on [[Mustafarian toast]] for 5.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as part of its breakfast [[Pantoran Plate Specials]]. The dish<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> shared its name with [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Diet/Legends|herbivore]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Guide to Alien Species">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Cream chipped bantha beef was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
